ModMetaData.name: Mech Upgrade Policies
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description:
Allows defining automatic upgrade policies for mech upgrades from https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3365118555.
You can specify policies the same way you would apparel for a colonist.
The mechs with that policy will then try to fill their upgrade points from the auto mech upgraders (Replace your existing one with one of these).
When a mech has unwanted upgrades (Per the policy), the auto upgrade will try to remove them.
Source available at: https://github.com/Ordoxous/RimworldMods/tree/master/MechUpgradesUi
